newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin, Clinton plan energy summit in Moscow.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin, Clinton plan energy summit in Moscow.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin will host U.S. President Bill Clinton in Moscow in March or April next year for a summit focusing on energy problems, First Deputy Prime Minister Boris Nemtsov said on Monday.

Itar-Tass news agency quoted Nemtsov, who is also energy minister, as saying after talks with U.S. Secretary of Energy Federico Pena that the summit would precede a meeting in Moscow of the Group of Seven industrial nations and Russia.

Plans for the G7 meeting, which will also focus on energy, was agreed at a G7 summit in Denver last month which Yeltsin attended with the leaders the United States, Britain, France, Germany, Japan, Italy and Canada.
